text:
jess: Heads up — noticed cross-tenant telemetry tags showing up in the console dashboards during load testing. Query for acme-org shows spikes attributed to beta-corp.
ben: Yikes. Can you paste a quick repro or logs? Is this metrics ingestion or the dashboard join?
jess: Repro steps: (1) curl the console route with X-Redwood-Org: acme, (2) trigger a run that emits telemetry, (3) check /internal/metrics/streams. Example header/response snippet:
```
> curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer token-for-acme" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme" https://console.redwood/api/run
> ...
< X-Redwood-Org: acme
< X-Proxy-Trace: ok
```
But in the metrics stream we see a sampled event: `org_id=beta-corp` and the payload includes acme-run-id. So payload/owner mismatch.
chandan: My first thought — header mutation in the gateway/sidecar or sample agent picking the wrong context when async-enqueueing. We had a similar bug where a reused worker goroutine left old org in thread-local.
mike: Can you dump the producer log at DEBUG for the sampling window? If the sampler uses a request-scoped context that escapes, you'll see old values in the worker flush. Also check cookie/affinity rewrite rules in the vhost config.
jess: Pasted a tiny log sample from metrics-producer (trimmed):
```
[2025-08-03T14:12:01Z] enqueue sample run_id=R-123 org=beta-corp trace=...
[2025-08-03T14:12:01Z] flush batch size=12 producer-context-org=beta-corp
```
But run meta shows owner=acme in DB for R-123.
maria: Short-term mitigation: stop sampling for console routes (set sampling_rate=0) or tag samples with token-subject from introspection so we have a fallback truth. We should also add a hard assertion in the gateway: if X-Redwood-Org header doesn't match token introspection, log with high priority and drop the sample.
ben: Good call. Who wants to own the fix? We should prioritize a small fix + test rather than re-architect telemetry.
chandan: Proposed action plan:
1) Add assertion in gateway proxy: verify header/org from token_introspect before forwarding to metrics queue. If mismatch, attach `x-rd-org-mismatch: true` and increment counter.
2) Change metrics-producer to prefer token-subject when present for sampled events (fallback to header only if token missing).
3) Add unit test that simulates two concurrent requests where worker reuse could cause stash carryover.
4) Canary rollout: staging -> 5% prod -> 100% with telemetry guarded flag.
mike: I'll run the concurrency unit reproducer and open a small PR to add the test and guard in the worker pool code. Putting a mutex around the context pop/push should be quick. :eyes:
jess: Thanks — can we also add a dashboard alert for `x_rd_org_mismatch_total` so we catch it in the future? Put it in platform-ops runbook.
maria: I'll flip the sampling flag on console routes to 0 for the next 12h and coordinate with SRE. Doing that now.
infra-bot: deploy job #4823 triggered: toggle sampling=0 on console-route for tenant telemetry (canary: false)
ben: Ownership: mike -> worker fix + test; chandan -> gateway assertion + counter; jess -> add alert/runbook; maria -> sampling toggle + coordination. ETA: small fix + canary in 48h? :shipit:
jess: Sounds good. Please add short PR descriptions and link the test harness. If somebody runs into more examples, paste the minimal logs here.
mike: Will do, opening PR in a bit and pinging this thread. :thumbsup:
